title: Casper and the Colony
author: Coral Reyes
blurb: Wendell Pemberton, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
